### Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – April 23, 2026

#### Balance Hotfix Update

This is a balance hotfix update. Replay codes from the April 14, 2026 patch and onwards are still available.

#### Hero Balance Updates

These changes aim to re-adjust heroes whose win rates have fallen further than intended since the start of Season 2. We’re continuing to monitor mobile heroes adjusted this season to help inform the mid‑season changes. Our focus is on ensuring heroes feel viable and fun to play both as and against, while still meeting our goal of addressing mobility.

![Roadhog](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/KCsJ/256X256/b8afaed1ce60cbddfc555d778839d4670868537a4319814da4ba13cdd1159887-t.png)

##### Roadhog

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/QrD7/128X128/7edc1cdef13c2fd21e279043816aa1d2975dc784298502fd121b927729e1e86d-t.png)

Chain Hook

* Cooldown reduced from 8 to 7 seconds.

![Sombra](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/Fc7j/256X256/4fa20d93cb1de8fcee163484d5dbd5ec1dd04d234019eaf4b7c159d3a62be64a-t.png)

##### Sombra

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/OmGj/128X128/patch-2026-04-23-28d15a6a00-04-t.png)

Stealth

* Movement speed bonus reduction while revealed by damage reduced from 50% to 33%.

![Vendetta](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/FhPk/256X256/53109fa61b9fcdd83ca94ceb96a1321253a744e1b1319e2645a29264812988b4-t.png)

##### Vendetta

* Health increased from 175 to 200. (Total health increased from 250 to 275.)

#### Major Bug Fixes

![Mizuki](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/wHro/256X256/8c5f25e135a5f200951caf4321be961a5ecbdfbe21a9c9fb96c6d17e0d887854-t.png)

##### Mizuki

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/qfDC/128X128/291ad4dfccb3678979f4f5ca8c24d219b9bb61a383731057547760646dcd5c04-t.png)

Katashiro Return

* Enemies can no longer prevent Mizuki from recalling by standing on Katashiro Return's starting point.

#### Stadium Hero Updates

![Hazard](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/WKRX/256X256/f5f6c3e6378f59c991cc60d817ec0f8b73b6957c277ff1ce23e89895ed6c6628-t.png)

##### Hazard

We're lowering the ceiling and total resource that Hazard's Spike Guard oriented builds gain, so there's more windows of opportunity for counterplay.

## Off the Wall

* Damage decreased from 60 to 40.

## Woof Woof!

* Extra [Spike Guard] Resource reduced from 30% to 15%.
* [Violent Leap] Hit Bonus Energy decreased from 15% to 10%.

## Hit Me Again

* Movement Speed penalty reduction decreased from 90% reduced to 50% reduced.

## Phreak Foil

* Extra [Spike Guard] Resource bonus decreased from 50% to 25%.
* [Jagged Wall] Hits Bonus Energy decreased from 25% to 15%.

![Junker Queen](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/BRCr/256X256/a362b9dba4f5f4f704076945f3c72d7d442d536ffcc2fc5735062f4a1cee8031-t.png)

##### Junker Queen

Royal Bullets has enabled Junker Queen to be dominant for several seasons now, so we're tuning it down to bring her more in line with other tanks in Stadium.

## Royal Bullets

* Wound damage decreased from 40 to 25.

![Orisa](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/YMNT/256X256/76707145df847f90e838e93b33979d5a275d1702a6e800dc6abb6a40652c1a82-t.png)

##### Orisa

## Restortify

* Healing reduced from 8% of Max Life per second to 5% of Max Life per second.

## Enhanced Target Sensors

* Bonus damage decreased from 25% to 10%.
* Attack Speed stat bonus decreased from 10% to 5%.
* Cost increased from 4000 to 5000.

![Ramattra](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/m8EN/256X256/f54a877264e161c2aa4d5755ef4411eb7fd7e4eb910075936e91ddb043b8a58e-t.png)

##### Ramattra

Ramattra has started with a middling win rate in Stadium, but as his builds become more optimized, some of them have proven to be outliers. We're tuning back some of his Ravenous Vortex / Nemesis Form oriented Powers, and we're improving his Weapon Power oriented options.

## Retaliation

* Maximum damage increased to 150.

## Dreadknight

* [Annihilation] Duration bonus decreased from 2s to 1s.

## Conversion Protocol

* Healing decreased from 50% to 25% of damage mitigated.

## Voracious Maelstrom

* [Nemesis Form] Cooldown Reduction per enemy hit by [Ravenous Vortex] reduced from 1s to 0.5s.

## Void Blight

* Void Blight damage increased from 20 to 30.

## R-7000 Powercell

* Cost decreased from 12000 to 10000.

## Recursion Relay

* Damage amplification increased from 10% to 15%.

## Second Phase

* [Ravenous Vortex] cooldown reduction reduced from 100% to 75%.

## Final Form

* Final Form healing reduced from 80 to 50.

## Nano-Mender

* Re-enabled.

![Zarya](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/skCy/256X256/bdc3fb8aa2c87debc3d4565197b969c5c7b4f0c9059dd8ad3335c8e536a91e0f-t.png)

##### Zarya

* Increased currency earned from Healing and Damage by 7.14%.

![Freja](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/fOsw/256X256/6eb3ff52171f525f38f1b92989accd570ffe1e6ab589a935abfc2af5d7da27d7-t.png)

##### Freja

## Volley à Deux

* Additional bolt damage decreased from 50% reduced damage to 60% reduced damage.

![Ana](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/FfFC/256X256/3c87d470067d61c432815a4bc0c70b11f1b5379006da29625839da356b7c4ca1-t.png)

##### Ana

## Cluster Core

* Re-enabled.

![Brigitte](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/zUCN/256X256/dbc7d49f32020fed1033cb4bb99b55f7938d1a71108fe76edc589e42c8cd0977-t.png)

##### Brigitte

## Packstacker

* [Repair Pack] Duration bonus decreased from 50% to 25%.

![Juno](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/6jTg/256X256/c6fd15df25b419c58a4c11569a8bc76e14a8e8c89ea689614a7cf3e8f2294c50-t.png)

##### Juno

We're fixing some bugs that popped up with the recent changes to Juno and adding a bit more firepower to her Weapon Power oriented builds.

## MediMaster

* Critical damage increased from 175% to 200%.

## Long Range Blaster

* [Mediblaster] Falloff range bonus increased from 5m to 15m.

## Heal Formation

* Re-enabled.

![Wuyang](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/LQVI/256X256/a9c2038a0c0b85aff625cd316a6b32764618170e78bb3edfe8c31ecf1a2a073d-t.png)

##### Wuyang

Water College Hat is a little too efficient for its cost, causing it to be mandatory for many Wuyang builds. We're adjusting it to give value more in line with its cost.

## Water College Hat

* Passive [Restoration Stream] Duration bonus reduced from 50% to 25%.
* Overhealth per second reduced from 10 to 5.
* Max Overhealth decreased from 30 to 15.
* Cost increased from 4000 to 5000.

#### Bug Fixes

General

* In a previous update, fixed an issue where custom bindings would not be saved.
* In a previous update, fixed an issue causing the framerate limit on Nintendo Switch 2 to be lower than intended.
* In a previous update, fixed an issue with Reaper's Trigger Finger Perk that allowed for an unintended animation cancel.
* In a previous update, fixed a bug with Sierra's Tight Grip Perk erroneously granting cooldown reduction on Tremor Charge.
* In a previous update, fixed a bug with Mercy's Double Dose Perk not correctly reducing the healing on Flash Heal.

Stadium

* Fixed an issue where players could be kicked for inactivity during the Armoury Phase.
* Fixed a bug where Ramattra's Insatiable Spiral bonus [Ravenous Vortex] damage was calculated additively instead of multiplicatively.
* Fixed a bug where Ramattra's Void Blight applied to barriers.
* Fixed a bug where Ramattra's Void Blight could not be cleansed.
* Fixed an issue where Ramattra's Nano-Mender could heal enemies.
* Fixed an issue where Gloomgauntlet's Melee Damage stat bonus did not apply to Ramattra's [Pummel].
* Fixed a bug where Vendetta's Overloaded Strike's [Sundering Blade] strike incorrectly calculated the 50% bonus damage additively and not multiplicatively.
* Fixed a bug where Ana's Cluster Core Hero Item would count certain non-player entities towards Cluster Core's cooldown reduction.
* Fixed a bug where Juno's Heal Formation would heal more than intended.

### 《守望先锋》正式服更新说明 – 2026年4月23日

#### 平衡性热修复更新

本次为平衡性热修复更新。2026年4月14日补丁及之后的录像回放代码仍可使用。

#### 英雄平衡性更新

这些调整旨在重新平衡自第2赛季开始以来胜率下降超出预期的英雄。我们正在持续监测本赛季调整过的机动型英雄，以为赛季中期更新提供参考。我们的重点是确保英雄在作为使用者和对抗者时都能感到既有强度又有趣，同时仍能实现我们针对机动性的调整目标。

![路霸](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/KCsJ/256X256/b8afaed1ce60cbddfc555d778839d4670868537a4319814da4ba13cdd1159887-t.png)

##### 路霸

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/QrD7/128X128/7edc1cdef13c2fd21e279043816aa1d2975dc784298502fd121b927729e1e86d-t.png)

链钩

* 冷却时间从8秒缩短至7秒。

![黑影](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/Fc7j/256X256/4fa20d93cb1de8fcee163484d5dbd5ec1dd04d234019eaf4b7c159d3a62be64a-t.png)

##### 黑影

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/OmGj/128X128/patch-2026-04-23-28d15a6a00-04-t.png)

隐身

* 因受到伤害显形时的移动速度加成削减效果从50%降低至33%。

![斩仇](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/FhPk/256X256/53109fa61b9fcdd83ca94ceb96a1321253a744e1b1319e2645a29264812988b4-t.png)

##### 斩仇

* 生命值从175提高至200。（总生命值从250提高至275。）

#### 重大错误修复

![瑞稀](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/wHro/256X256/8c5f25e135a5f200951caf4321be961a5ecbdfbe21a9c9fb96c6d17e0d887854-t.png)

##### 瑞稀

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/qfDC/128X128/291ad4dfccb3678979f4f5ca8c24d219b9bb61a383731057547760646dcd5c04-t.png)

替魂纸人

* 敌人现在无法再通过站在“替魂纸人”的起始点来阻止瑞稀召回。

#### 角斗领域英雄更新

![骇灾](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/WKRX/256X256/f5f6c3e6378f59c991cc60d817ec0f8b73b6957c277ff1ce23e89895ed6c6628-t.png)

##### 骇灾

我们正在降低骇灾以“尖刺护卫”为核心的流派所能获得的上限和总资源，从而为对手提供更多的反制机会。

## 墙立猛推

* 伤害从60降低至40。

## 汪汪！

* 额外的[尖刺护卫]资源从30%降低至15%。
* [狂暴跃击]命中奖励能量从15%降低至10%。

## 碰我试试

* 移动速度惩罚削减效果从90%降低至50%。

## 怪咖线圈

* 额外的[尖刺护卫]资源加成从50%降低至25%。
* [锯齿墙]命中奖励能量从25%降低至15%。

![渣客女王](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/BRCr/256X256/a362b9dba4f5f4f704076945f3c72d7d442d536ffcc2fc5735062f4a1cee8031-t.png)

##### 渣客女王

“皇家子弹”已让渣客女王在数个赛季中占据统治地位，因此我们正在对其进行下调，使其在角斗领域中与其他重装英雄的表现更加一致。

## 皇家子弹

* 创伤伤害从40降低至25。

![奥丽莎](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/YMNT/256X256/76707145df847f90e838e93b33979d5a275d1702a6e800dc6abb6a40652c1a82-t.png)

##### 奥丽莎

## 强固回复

* 治疗效果从每秒最大生命值的8%降低至每秒最大生命值的5%。

## 强化目标传感器

* 伤害加成从25%降低至10%。
* 攻击速度属性加成从10%降低至5%。
* 消耗从4000提高至5000。

![拉玛刹](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/m8EN/256X256/f54a877264e161c2aa4d5755ef4411eb7fd7e4eb910075936e91ddb043b8a58e-t.png)

##### 拉玛刹

拉玛刹在角斗领域初期的胜率平平，但随着其流派逐渐优化，部分流派的表现已超出预期。我们正在调低他部分以“贪婪漩涡”/“天神形态”为核心的威能，并提升他以武器威能为核心的选项。

## 反击铁臂

* 最大伤害提高至150。

## 恐惧骑士

* [歼灭]持续时间加成从2秒降低至1秒。

## 转换协议

* 治疗效果从减免伤害的50%降低至25%。

## 贪婪漩涡

* [天神形态]下“贪婪漩涡”每命中一名敌人的冷却缩减从1秒降低至0.5秒。

## 虚空凋零

* 虚空凋零伤害从20提高至30。

## R-7000电池

* 消耗从12000降低至10000。

## 递归导能

* 伤害放大效果从10%提高至15%。

## 第二阶段

* [贪婪漩涡]冷却缩减从100%降低至75%。

## 最终形态

* 最终形态治疗量从80降低至50。

## 纳米治疗器

* 已重新启用。

![查莉娅](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/skCy/256X256/bdc3fb8aa2c87debc3d4565197b969c5c7b4f0c9059dd8ad3335c8e536a91e0f-t.png)

##### 查莉娅

* 从治疗和伤害中获得的货币增加了7.14%。

![弗蕾娅](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/fOsw/256X256/6eb3ff52171f525f38f1b92989accd570ffe1e6ab589a935abfc2af5d7da27d7-t.png)

##### 弗蕾娅

## 双箭在侧

* 额外箭矢的伤害削减从50%降低伤害调整为60%降低伤害。

![安娜](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/FfFC/256X256/3c87d470067d61c432815a4bc0c70b11f1b5379006da29625839da356b7c4ca1-t.png)

##### 安娜

## 集束核心

* 已重新启用。

![布丽吉塔](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/zUCN/256X256/dbc7d49f32020fed1033cb4bb99b55f7938d1a71108fe76edc589e42c8cd0977-t.png)

##### 布丽吉塔

## 愈战愈久

* [修复包]持续时间加成从50%降低至25%。

![朱诺](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/6jTg/256X256/c6fd15df25b419c58a4c11569a8bc76e14a8e8c89ea689614a7cf3e8f2294c50-t.png)

##### 朱诺

我们正在修复朱诺近期改动中出现的一些错误，并为其以武器威能为核心的流派增加一些火力。

## 医疗大师

* 暴击伤害从175%提高至200%。

## 远距冲击枪

* [医疗冲击枪]衰减距离加成从5米提高至15米。

## 治疗阵列

* 已重新启用。

![无漾](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/LQVI/256X256/a9c2038a0c0b85aff625cd316a6b32764618170e78bb3edfe8c31ecf1a2a073d-t.png)

##### 无漾

“水学院帽”相对于其消耗而言效率过高，导致它成为了许多无漾流派的必选项。我们正在对其进行调整，使其价值与消耗更加匹配。

## 水学院帽

* 被动[恢复之流]持续时间加成从50%降低至25%。
* 每秒提供的过量治疗从10降低至5。
* 最大过量治疗从30降低至15。
* 消耗从4000提高至5000。

#### 错误修复

综合

* 在之前的更新中，修复了自定义按键绑定无法保存的问题。
* 在之前的更新中，修复了导致 Nintendo Switch 2 帧率限制低于预期的问题。
* 在之前的更新中，修复了死神的“快枪手”威能允许非预期动作取消的问题。
* 在之前的更新中，修复了西拉的“紧握”威能错误地为“震荡充能”提供冷却缩减的问题。
* 在之前的更新中，修复了天使的“双倍剂量”威能未能正确降低“闪速治疗”治疗量的问题。

角斗领域

* 修复了玩家在军械库阶段可能因不活跃而被踢出比赛的问题。
* 修复了拉玛刹的“贪婪螺旋”额外[贪婪漩涡]伤害按加法而非乘法计算的错误。
* 修复了拉玛刹的“虚空凋零”会作用于屏障的错误。
* 修复了拉玛刹的“虚空凋零”无法被净化的错误。
* 修复了拉玛刹的“纳米治疗器”会治疗敌人的问题。
* 修复了“幽冥手套”的近战伤害属性加成不适用于拉玛刹的[猛击]的问题。
* 修复了斩仇的“过载打击”中[裂空之刃]打击错误地按加法而非乘法计算50%额外伤害的错误。
* 修复了安娜的“集束核心”英雄物品会将某些非玩家实体计入“集束核心”冷却缩减的错误。
* 修复了朱诺的“治疗阵列”治疗量高于预期的错误。
